{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for LOYAL and completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA outliers: any row with revenue_clean == 999999.99
outlier_mask = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
outlier_count = outlier_mask.sum()

# Extract the outlier rows for inspection
outlier_rows = df_loyal_completed[outlier_mask]

# Compute mean revenue excluding outliers
mean_revenue_clean = df_loyal_completed.loc[~outlier_mask, 'revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Total LOYAL, completed orders: {len(df_loyal_completed)}")
print(f"QA outliers found (revenue_clean == 999999.99): {outlier_count}")
print(f"Outlier rows (first 3):\n{outlier_rows[['order_id', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']][:3]}")
print(f"Mean revenue (excluding outliers): {mean_revenue_clean:.2f}")"}
